4:06|:type: and :rtype: gives false ambiguous class lookup warnings
5:55|**Describe the bug**
6:de|The implicit xrefs created by the info fields ``:type:`` and ``:rtype:`` seems to do lookup differently than explicit xref roles. For unqualified names it seems like they search for the name in every (sub)module instead of in the current module and then parent modules.
7:00|

9:99|```rst

20:99|	:rtype: mod.A
21:0d|	:rtype: mod.submod.A
22:00|
23:a7|.. py:currentmodule:: mod
24:00|
25:33|.. py:function:: f()
26:00|
27:f6|	- :py:class:`A`

30:00|

35:99|	:rtype: mod.A

37:00|
38:96|.. py:currentmodule:: mod.submod
39:00|

43:c9|	- :py:class:`mod.A`
44:95|	- :py:class:`mod.submod.A`
45:00|
46:10|	:param A a: BUG: links to mod.A instead of mod.submod.A
47:42|	:param mod.A b:
48:0e|	:param mod.submod.A c:

50:99|	:rtype: mod.A
51:0d|	:rtype: mod.submod.A
52:cd|```
53:4e|gives the warnings
54:cd|```
55:56|index.rst:28: WARNING: more than one target found for cross-reference 'A': mod.A, mod.submod.A
